name: UpdatePipeline

parameters.help_en: The name of the AgentSpace where the pipeline to be updated is located
parameters.help_zh: AgentSpace 名称，定位待更新流水线所在的 AgentSpace
parameters.name: agent_space

parameters.help_en: The name of the pipeline to be updated
parameters.name: pipeline_name

parameters.help_en: The description of the pipeline, which helps business users understand its purpose
parameters.help_zh: 流水线描述，便于业务方理解用途
parameters.name: description

fields.help_en: The bootstrap start time, specified as a UNIX timestamp in seconds. The precision is the same as that of runOnce or scheduled.fromTime. Millisecond values greater than or equal to 1e12 are automatically converted to seconds. The cursor starts from this time aligned to the grid and catches up window by window. After catching up, it switches to minute intervals. By default, the cursor starts from the current time and processes only incremental data
fields.help_zh: bootstrap 历史起点，Unix 秒时间戳（与 runOnce/scheduled.fromTime 同精度；≥1e12 的毫秒值自动兼容折算）：游标从该时刻网格对齐起步逐窗追平，追平后转分钟间隔；缺省从当前时刻起步只看增量
fields.name: from_time

fields.help_en: The continuous execution configuration. This parameter is used when the type is trace. The processing frequency is a fixed value managed by the server
fields.help_zh: 持续执行配置（type 为 trace 时使用；处理频率为服务端管理的固定值）
fields.name: continuous

fields.help_en: The scheduling mode. Valid values: RunOnce (single execution), Scheduled (periodic execution), and Continuous (continuous execution, applicable only to trace data sources). For Continuous mode, the processing frequency is a fixed value managed by the server, and data is automatically processed at minute intervals after the trace is completed
fields.help_zh: 调度模式：RunOnce（单次执行）、Scheduled（周期执行）或 Continuous（持续执行，仅 trace 数据源；处理频率为服务端管理的固定值，Trace 完成后分钟级自动处理）
fields.name: mode

fields.help_en: The start time of the data processing window, specified as a UNIX timestamp in seconds. The value must be less than the value of toTime
fields.help_zh: 数据处理窗口起始时间，Unix 秒，必须小于 toTime
fields.name: from_time

fields.help_en: The end time of the data processing window, specified as a UNIX timestamp in seconds. The value must be greater than the value of fromTime
fields.help_zh: 数据处理窗口结束时间，Unix 秒，必须大于 fromTime
fields.name: to_time

fields.help_en: The single execution configuration. This parameter is required only when the mode is set to RunOnce
fields.help_zh: 单次执行配置，仅 mode 为 RunOnce 时必填
fields.name: run_once

fields.help_en: The scheduling start time, specified as a UNIX timestamp in seconds. The precision is the same as that of runOnce.fromTime. Millisecond values greater than or equal to 1e12 are automatically converted to seconds
fields.help_zh: 调度起始时间，Unix 秒时间戳（与 runOnce.fromTime 同精度；≥1e12 的毫秒值自动兼容折算）
fields.name: from_time

fields.help_en: The scheduling interval. Valid values: 1h, 6h, 12h, and 1d
fields.help_zh: 调度间隔，支持 1h / 6h / 12h / 1d
fields.name: interval

fields.help_en: The periodic scheduling configuration. This parameter is required only when the mode is set to Scheduled
fields.help_zh: 周期调度配置，仅 mode 为 Scheduled 时必填
fields.name: scheduled

parameters.help_en: The scheduling policy. If this parameter is specified, the existing policy is completely overwritten
parameters.help_zh: 调度方式，传入即整体覆盖
parameters.name: execute_policy

fields.help_en: The ID of the node
fields.help_zh: 节点 Id
fields.name: id

fields.help_en: The parameters of the node. The parameters use a key-value structure and vary based on the node type
fields.help_zh: 节点参数，键值结构，随节点类型而定
fields.name: parameters

fields.help_en: The type of the node
fields.help_zh: 节点类型
fields.name: type

fields.help_en: The list of nodes
fields.help_zh: 节点列表
fields.name: nodes

parameters.help_en: The pipeline configuration, which defines node orchestration. If this parameter is specified, the existing configuration is completely overwritten
parameters.help_zh: Pipeline 配置（节点编排），传入即整体覆盖
parameters.name: pipeline

fields.help_zh: 未命中任何条件路由时使用的默认写入目标

fields.help_en: The name of the destination dataset
fields.help_zh: 目标数据集名称

fields.help_zh: Dataset Sink 的目标数据集配置，仅 sink.type 为 dataset 时使用

parameters.help_zh: Pipeline 目标（数据写入目标），传入即整体覆盖

fields.help_en: The name of the source dataset
fields.help_zh: 源 Dataset 名称
fields.name: dataset

fields.help_zh: Dataset 数据过滤条件

fields.help_zh: 当前 AgentSpace 下的 Dataset 数据源配置

fields.help_en: The name of the field
fields.help_zh: 字段名称
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: The type of the field. Valid values: text, long, double, and json
fields.help_zh: 字段类型，支持 text、long、double、json
fields.name: type

fields.help_zh: 输入字段及字段类型，适用于所有数据源类型

fields.help_en: The name of the SLS Logstore
fields.help_zh: SLS Logstore 名称
fields.name: logstore

fields.help_en: The name of the SLS project
fields.help_zh: SLS Project 名称

fields.help_en: The filtered query statement in SLS query and analysis syntax
fields.help_zh: 数据筛选查询语句（SLS 查询/分析语法）
fields.name: query

fields.help_zh: SLS Logstore 数据源配置
fields.name: logstore

fields.help_en: The list of enrichment columns. This parameter is retained for compatibility. The current implementation outputs a single fixed column agent_trajectory, and this parameter no longer affects the output
fields.help_zh: 富化列清单（兼容保留）：当前实现固定输出单列 agent_trajectory，本参数不再影响输出
fields.name: columns

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable trajectory enrichment
fields.help_zh: 是否开启轨迹富化
fields.name: enabled

fields.help_en: The trajectory enrichment. It mounts trajectory data into the scrubbing result by trace_id. When writing to a dataset, the data is carried in the fixed column agent_trajectory, where the column value is the trajectory JSON content
fields.help_zh: 轨迹富化：按 trace_id 将轨迹数据挂载进清洗结果；写入数据集时以固定列 agent_trajectory 承载（列值为轨迹 JSON 内容）
fields.name: enrich

fields.help_en: The trajectory data configuration. This parameter is optional and takes effect only when type is set to trace. It obtains ATIF standard trajectory data from the trajectory scrubbing service and extends it by feature
fields.help_zh: 轨迹数据配置（可选，type 为 trace 时生效）：从轨迹清洗服务获取 ATIF 标准轨迹数据，按功能扩展
fields.name: trajectory

fields.help_en: The data source type. Valid values: logstore, dataset, and trace. The trace value indicates a trajectory signal-driven processing mode. The validity of the enum values is verified by the server
fields.help_zh: 数据源类型，支持 logstore、dataset 或 trace（trace 为轨迹信号驱动处理模式；枚举合法性由服务端校验）
fields.name: type

parameters.help_en: The pipeline data source. Passing this parameter overwrites the entire configuration
